chunks: "Appoint me over the granaries of the land," (he said); "I shall be a knowledgeable keeper."
ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Joseph say to secure his position as the manager of Egypt's granaries?
ai.summary: In this verse, Prophet Joseph (Yusuf) requests the position of treasurer for Egypt's grain reserves, citing his attributes of 'Hafizun' (one who preserves/keeps) and 'Alim' (one who knows) as evidence of his competence. Shia scholars often highlight this as a model of administrative justice, where a righteous individual utilizes their divine knowledge and trustworthiness to manage public resources effectively during times of crisis.
